en.headline: Boy, 10, in serious condition with flu and shock
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection said the child tested positive for influenza A and remains in intensive care, taking serious paediatric cases since late June to 22.
body: A 10-year-old boy is in serious condition in hospital after influenza A with shock, the Centre for Health Protection said on Monday. He had been in good health before he developed a fever, cough, runny nose and dizziness on 2 October.

The centre said he was taken to the accident and emergency department at Prince of Wales Hospital on 4 October and was admitted the same day to the paediatric intensive care unit. A respiratory sample tested positive for influenza A, and Wen Wei Po reported the laboratory result as influenza A (H1). Clinicians diagnosed influenza A complicated by shock. He remains in hospital in serious condition.

Preliminary inquiries found he had not travelled during the incubation period and had not received this season's influenza vaccine, the centre said. One household contact recently had a mild fever and upper-respiratory symptoms and has since recovered. The investigation is continuing.

Hong Kong has been in a flu season since late June, and the centre said overall activity remains high. It has recorded 22 serious influenza cases in children since then. Wen Wei Po, citing the centre, said 16 of those children had recovered and been discharged, two were stable, two were serious, one was critical and one had died. Since schools resumed in September, the centre has received reports of nearly 350 influenza-like outbreaks in schools, affecting more than 2,000 people. It urged people to get vaccinated and to keep up personal and environmental hygiene.

zh.headline: 十歲男童染甲流併發休克 情況嚴重
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心說，男童對甲型流感呈陽性，仍在兒童深切治療部留醫，6月底至今兒童嚴重個案累計22宗。
body: 衞生防護中心星期一公布，一名10歲男童感染甲型流感併發休克，目前留醫，情況嚴重。男童過往健康良好，本月2日出現發燒、咳嗽、流鼻水和頭暈。
中心說，男童本月4日被帶到威爾斯親王醫院急症室，同日轉往兒童深切治療部。呼吸道樣本證實對甲型流感病毒呈陽性，《文匯報》引述化驗結果為甲型（H1）流感。臨床診斷為甲型流感併發休克，病人仍在留醫，情況嚴重。
初步調查顯示，男童潛伏期內沒有外遊，亦未接種本季流感疫苗。一名家居接觸者近日曾有輕微發燒和上呼吸道症狀，病情輕微，現已康復。中心會繼續調查。
本港自6月底進入流感季節，中心說整體活躍程度仍處高水平，期間累計22宗兒童流感嚴重個案。《文匯報》引述中心稱，其中16宗已康復出院、兩宗穩定、兩宗嚴重、一宗危殆、一宗死亡。9月開學後，學校流感樣疾病爆發報告近350宗，影響逾2000人。中心呼籲市民盡快接種疫苗，並保持個人和環境衞生。
